description: PAID ($0.001 USDC via x402). Shows one instant in up to 20 IANA time zones (localTime with offset, utcOffset, abbreviation, isDst, dayOfWeek, date). `time` with Z/offset is absolute; without, it is wall-clock in `from` (default UTC). A skipped local time moves forward by the gap, a repeated one takes the earlier instant (localTimeIssue + alternativeInstantUtc). Rules come from the tz database built into the server; future dates use today's published rules. An unknown zone answers 404, bad input 400; neither is charged. Without payment this returns the 402 challenge; the fiatdock-mcp npm package pays automatically. Any answer the tool cannot produce is >= 400 and is NOT charged.

from.description: IANA time zone a local `time` is read in (and shown in as fromLocalTime), e.g. America/New_York; default UTC

payment.description: Base64 of a single x402 v2 PaymentPayload (EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization on Base USDC). OMIT it on the first call: the 402 you get back carries `howToPay.payloadTemplate` — the exact envelope to fill in — plus the price and the EIP-712 domain. Send it on the second call to complete the purchase; it is forwarded as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, never as body data. Nothing is charged for the 402 itself, and a call that fails after payment settles nothing.

time.description: The moment to convert, ISO 8601: with Z or an offset ("2026-10-08T15:00:00Z", "2026-10-08T15:00+02:00") it is an absolute instant; without one ("2026-10-08T15:00") it is wall-clock time in `from`; a bare date means 00:00 there. Years 1970-2100. Default: now

to.description: IANA time zones to show the instant in, up to 20 (default America/Los_Angeles,America/New_York,Europe/London,Europe/Berlin,Asia/Dubai,Asia/Kolkata,Asia/Tokyo,Australia/Sydney)

name: timezone_convert

alternativeInstantUtc.description: For an ambiguous local `time`: the LATER of its two instants, in UTC. null otherwise

asOf.description: ISO time the conversion was computed

from.description: The zone a local `time` was read in (default UTC)

fromLocalTime.description: The instant as wall-clock time in `from`, ISO 8601 with offset

inputWasLocal.description: True when `time` had no Z or offset and was read as wall-clock time in `from`

localTimeIssue.description: For a local `time` only: "nonexistent" = that wall-clock time does not happen in `from` (clocks went forward) and was moved forward by the gap; "ambiguous" = it happens twice (clocks went back) and the EARLIER instant was taken. null otherwise

note.description: How a local time, DST and the abbreviation are decided, and the limits

source.description: Where the time zone rules came from (the tz database version compiled into this server)

times.description: The instant in each requested zone, in the order asked

abbreviation.description: ICU's English short name (EDT, PST — or just GMT+2 where English has none)

isDst.description: On daylight-saving time at that instant (inferred from offsets — see note)

localTime.description: Wall-clock time there, ISO 8601 with the zone's offset (2026-10-08T17:00:00+02:00)

resolvedZone.description: The tz identifier ICU resolves it to — a link resolves to the zone it names (US/Eastern → America/New_York; Asia/Kolkata → Asia/Calcutta, the same zone)

utcOffset.description: The zone's UTC offset at that instant (+02:00)

zone.description: The zone as asked (case-corrected when ICU knows the same name)

title: Time zone conversion (IANA tz database, DST-aware) ($0.001)
